raw_response:
I will keep my land in the usual winter wheat and summer maize rotation. In Quzhou County, that is the safest way for me to use the whole year and keep grain coming off the same fields twice. I will finish the current winter wheat crop with steady water and fertilizer, because wheat is already established and gives me secure grain and straw. After wheat harvest, I will plant summer maize right away on the same land, because maize fits our heat and rain season and works well after wheat. I will use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed because I want stable emergence, stronger resistance, and better yield. I will not spread my land into too many crops, because that makes management harder and raises risk for me. I will focus on timely irrigation, enough base fertilizer plus topdressing, clean field management, and a small number of pesticide sprays only when the main pests and diseases show up. I will use rotary tillage for wheat ground preparation, then no-tillage for maize after wheat harvest so I can save time and catch soil moisture.
